exposure: ADHD stimulant medication use (dextro-/amphetamine, methylphenidate, lisdexamfetamine)
outcome: prevalence trends of perinatal ADHD stimulant medication use
patterns of stimulant medication use and discontinuation
maternal characteristics associated with prenatal stimulant use (parity, income, hypertension, BMI, smoking, other psychotropic medication use)
cohort: The study included 899,679 pregnancies among all pregnant people with deliveries in British Columbia, Canada, between January 2000 and December 2021.
finding: Prenatal ADHD stimulant medication use in British Columbia increased 11-fold between 2000 and 2021, reaching 4.3/1000 pregnancies, primarily due to dextro-/amphetamine, with a high rate of discontinuation (77%) among preconception users during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Pregnant people taking stimulant medications were more likely to deliver by cesarean section.
